# incident.io — account brief

## Who

incident.io describes itself as "All-in-one incident management — Declare, run, and learn from incidents without leaving Slack. Incident management for teams that ship software." ([source](https://incident.io/)). Its GitHub org `incident-io` lists incident.io as its website ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `incident-io/on-call-app` ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in that repo pins react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 38 public repos and 520 followers ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).
- `incident-io/on-call-app` was last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)).
- incident.io On-call has 3,100 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- There were 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- An open issue reads "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)).
- An open issue reads "Track: upgrade to Expo SDK 53" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).
- incident.io is hiring a "Product Engineer, Mobile (React Native)" per "Ask HN: Who is hiring? (August 2026)" ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45311640)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@incident-io-maintainer-1), top contributor to `incident-io/on-call-app` with 174 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)). Their GitHub profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@incident-io-maintainer-2), top contributor to `incident-io/on-call-app` with 92 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)). Their GitHub profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@incident-io-maintainer-3), top contributor to `incident-io/on-call-app` with 45 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3)). Their GitHub profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

`incident-io/on-call-app` was last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)) and the app shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). An open issue tracks an upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)) while the repo still pins react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One — you have 174 commits in `incident-io/on-call-app` ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)), which ships with `eas.json` and CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json)). Issue #214 there is open on "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)), alongside issue #198 tracking the upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)). How are you sequencing the Xcode image fix against the SDK 53 upgrade in your build pipeline?
